interpretation.conclusion: Reweighting categories cuts the held-out error roughly threefold and reconciles the level and most contrasts, so composition is the dominant term. It is not the whole story: the optimum sits on a simplex boundary that no texture paper would actually use, and even there the NTC_PinkPEPS ordering is not recovered.

limitations: Eight free weights against eleven published numbers; the held-out error is the honest measure of fit, not the in-sample residual.

The least-squares optimum lands on a simplex boundary with zero weight on several categories, which is a fitting artefact rather than a credible selection; read the direction, not the literal weights.
Conflates a different category mix with different files inside each category; both are unpublished and cannot be separated here.
Category means pool three seeds and eighteen materials of our own selection, so they carry our material choice with them.
A best-fit composition estimates what would reconcile the numbers, not what the authors did.
note: Weights that best reproduce the eleven published values from our own per-category measurements. Assumes per-category difficulty is comparable between the paper's files and ours, which is exactly the assumption the unpublished file list prevents us from checking.
